title: Stability and convergence analysis of unconditionally original energy dissipative implicit-explicit Runge--Kutta methods for the phase field crystal models without Lipschitz assumptions
summary: The phase field crystal (PFC) method is an efficient technique for simulating the evolution of crystalline microstructures at atomistic length scales and diffusive time scales. Due to the high-order derivatives (sixth-order) and the strongly nonlinear term (locally Lipschitz), developing high-order stable schemes and establishing corresponding error estimates is particularly challenging.
